source: drivine4j 8be5e760, written by its own code (VectorGoldenWriter, not committed): only parameter names are normalized, the SQL stores' $_pN to $_cy_vec<N+1>, and the graph engines' $_vector…, $_among… names to $_cy_vec<n> in the order the statement first names them. The query vector's own binding, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3], is left out of parameters and named by "vector". The graph engines' 84 answers that write an index name, a label or a property with a quote or a backslash into the CALL between single quotes, or a root label that is no plain identifier into the among MATCH, were then edited by a script to write it escaped, as a Cypher string or a backtick-quoted label (liberation-data/drivine-cypher-spec#217). On store layout 2 (#161), Oracle's vector table is named as layout 2 names its objects, `<graph>_v2_…` for `<graph>_v_…`: that name alone was changed in its answers. The 168 SQL answers of a nearest search by cosine were then edited by a script to leave out a stored embedding of no length, as Neo4j's cosine index does, and the 40 of a search among ids by cosine to leave out such a root (liberation-data/drivine-cypher-spec#160). The 70 SQL answers of a search among ids were then edited by a script to read each root's place among the ids, as the search for each pair once reads it, and to break a tie of two neighbours' scores by their places, then their node ids; and Neo4j's and Memgraph's 32 answers of one (FalkorDB's 16 are as drivine4j wrote them, as no FalkorDB client can bind a map keyed by any id: #416), to bind each id's place as a map, `_cy_vec2`, the later parameters numbered on, read each hit's place by it, where the hit's id is text, keep a hit by its place in place of its id, and break a tie of two scores by place (liberation-data/drivine-cypher-spec#412). The 70 SQL answers of a search among ids were then edited by a script to find each root as a lookup by its id finds it, through the index over the id (IdSql.hasIdIn), and to join it to its place by the index's own expressions, the given ids read as each id's JSON, and to read each id back as IdSql.keyText reads it, so a temporal id is found by its tag (drivine4j#868).

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, (2 - (CAST(CAST((c.props -> 'embedding') AS text) AS vector) <=> CAST($_cy_vec1 AS vector))) / 2 AS score
FROM g_node c
WHERE c.labels @> '["Doc"]'
  AND jsonb_typeof((c.props -> 'embedding')) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length((c.props -> 'embedding')) = 3
  AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((c.props -> 'embedding')) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length((c.props -> 'embedding')) = 3 THEN vector_norm(CAST(CAST((c.props -> 'embedding') AS text) AS vector(3))) > 0 END
ORDER BY score DESC, c.nid
LIMIT $_cy_vec2

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, c.doc, (2 - VECTOR_DISTANCE(TO_VECTOR(JSON_QUERY(c.props, '$.embedding' RETURNING CLOB)), TO_VECTOR($_cy_vec1), COSINE)) / 2 AS score
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (g
    MATCH (c IS node WHERE JSON_EXISTS(c.labels, '$[*]?(@ == "Doc")') AND JSON_EXISTS(c.props, '$.embedding') AND VECTOR_DIMENSION_COUNT(TO_VECTOR(JSON_QUERY(c.props, '$.embedding' RETURNING CLOB))) = 3 AND VECTOR_NORM(TO_VECTOR(JSON_QUERY(c.props, '$.embedding' RETURNING CLOB))) > 0)
    COLUMNS (c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, c.doc)) c
ORDER BY score DESC, c.nid
FETCH FIRST $_cy_vec2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, (2 - (k.distance)) / 2 AS score
        FROM (
SELECT s.nid, CAST(CAST((s.props -> 'embedding') AS text) AS vector(3)) <=> CAST($_cy_vec1 AS vector(3)) AS distance
FROM g_node s
WHERE s.labels @> '["Doc"]'
  AND jsonb_typeof((s.props -> 'embedding')) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length((s.props -> 'embedding')) = 3
  AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((s.props -> 'embedding')) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length((s.props -> 'embedding')) = 3 THEN vector_norm(CAST(CAST((s.props -> 'embedding') AS text) AS vector(3))) > 0 END
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT $_cy_vec2) k
        JOIN g_node c ON c.nid = k.nid
        WHERE c.labels @> '["Doc"]'

SELECT c.nid, c.labels, c.props, c.stamp, JSON_TRANSFORM(c.props, SET '$.labels' = c.labels, SET '$."__drivine.stamp"' = c.stamp) AS doc, (2 - k.distance) / 2 AS score
FROM (SELECT s.nid, VECTOR_DISTANCE(s.embedding, TO_VECTOR($_cy_vec1), COSINE) AS distance FROM g_v2_Docembedding_f151d66f s WHERE VECTOR_NORM(s.embedding) > 0 ORDER BY distance FETCH APPROX FIRST $_cy_vec2 ROWS ONLY) k
JOIN g_node c ON c.nid = k.nid
WHERE INSTR(',' || LTRIM(RTRIM(JSON_SERIALIZE(c.labels), ']'), '[') || ',"', ',"Doc","') > 0
